notMeasured: PDF vs DOCX parse rates — the source file type is not stored, so the analyzer ran on extracted text only.
Bullet structure — text extraction normalises or strips bullet glyphs, so a low bullet count here is an extraction artefact, not the resume.

Any specific commercial ATS (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, iCIMS, Taleo, SAP). This benchmark tested the ResumeAtlas analyzer, which models the shared text-extraction stage — not any one vendor's parser.
Hiring outcomes — nothing here records whether a resume led to an interview.
sampleCaveat: These are resumes real people submitted to ResumeAtlas between the dates above, run through ResumeAtlas's own ATS-parse analyzer. The sample is small, skews toward software, data and engineering roles, and covers signed-in users only. Treat it as a directional ResumeAtlas study, not a definitive measure of every resume or every ATS.
